newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on buying apathy.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on buying apathy.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall further on Sunday as continued corrections appear to be discouraging buyers, brokers said.
"The downtrend may continue for the seventh straight session as investors, jittery over random corrections, are mostly trying to offload their shares," said broker A.H. Howlader.
The DSE all-share price index closed 85.86 points or 4.08 percent down at 2,015.10 on turnover of 36.2 million taka on Saturday. Friday was the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
